name: 10012 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10012 (New York) has 310 nonprofit organizations. 144 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 127 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10012 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10012 (New York) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
